product_name: FC-3000 智能铁磁探测系统
summary: FC-3000 智能铁磁探测系统是一款针对铁磁性物质设计的先进被动式探测设备。它融合了世界领先的磁通门检测技术与高性能 DSP 数字信号处理算法，突破了周围环境干扰对传统探测设备的限制。该系统具备高密度的 NT 级探测灵敏度，支持三分区精准定位，且具备非接触式、无源探测的特性，不发射任何电磁波。其便携式设计、长达 24 小时的续航能力以及隐蔽筛查功能，使其成为公检法、监狱及科研保密单位进行金属禁忌品检查的理想方案。
summary_en: The FC-3000 Intelligent Ferromagnetic Detection System is a high-performance passive detection device specifically engineered for identifying ferromagnetic materials. It incorporates world-leading fluxgate detection technology with state-of-the-art DSP digital signal processing algorithms, overcoming the environmental limitations that often restrict traditional detection equipment. The system features high-density nanotesla (nT) level sensitivity, supports accurate 3-zone positioning, and utilizes non-contact passive detection that emits no harmful electromagnetic waves. With its ultra-portable design, 24-hour battery life, and discreet/covert screening capabilities, it is an ideal solution for prohibited item inspections in judicial departments, prisons, and secure research facilities.
key_application: 应用领域：FC-3000 智能铁磁探测系统；被动式无源探测，无电磁辐射；高灵敏度识别各类磁性违禁品；支持隐蔽筛查与联网分级预警。
key_application_en: Passive electromagnetic-safe ferromagnetic detection; nanotesla-level sensitivity for hidden metals; 3-zone positioning for precise identification; discrete/covert screening capable; high-throughput 60+ ppm.
key_parameter_1: 探测灵敏度: 纳特斯拉 (nT) 级
key_parameter_2: 电池续航: ≥ 24 小时 (内置大容量锂电)

parameters.探测技术: 被动式磁通门检测 + 高性能 DSP 处理
parameters.识别能力: 精准探测含磁性金属及非金属 (铁、钴、镍及合金)
parameters.安全性: 无源探测，不产生电磁辐射，通过 CE/QMS 认证
parameters.警报模式: 可视化智能报警 (红/绿灯)、声音报警、可选隐蔽报警 (智能手表联接)
parameters.定位功能: 铁磁物品三分区定位显示
parameters.联网模式: 双柱联网支持分级预警 (打火机/手机/管制刀具区分)
parameters.探测范围: 半径 0 - 1.5 米 360 度全方位覆盖
parameters.结构材质: 轻量化高强度铝合金柱身

parameters_en.Technology: Passive Fluxgate Detection with High-Performance DSP Processing
parameters_en.Detection Targets: Precisely scans for ferromagnetic metals/non-metals (Iron, Cobalt, Nickel)
parameters_en.Radiation Safety: Passive sensing only; zero EM emission; certified CE/QMS
parameters_en.Alarm Interface: Visual alerts (Red/Green), high-fidelity audio, and optional discreet vibrating watch link
parameters_en.Spatial Resolution: 3-zone vertical positioning for accurate item localization
parameters_en.Intelligent Networking: Dual-column linking for hierarchical warnings (Lighter/Phone/Knife differentiation)
parameters_en.Industrial Rating: IP65 Weatherproof; suitable for indoor/outdoor use
parameters_en.Endurance: Internal Li-battery supports > 24 hours of operation; Type-C charging

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 领先磁通门架构：作为行业领先的被动式探测方案，能捕捉微弱磁场畸变，显著优于传统电磁安检门对非动性金属的感知。
  • 无害化安全探测：设备本身不产生磁场或热辐射，对佩戴起搏器、孕妇及精密电子存储设备的安全性达到 100%。
  • 分级梯次报警：联网模式下可根据磁通量特征，对打火机/手机/管制刀具自动识别并以不同色光提示风险等级。
  • 多场景隐性筛查：极简的柱形设计可轻易隐藏在隔断墙、装饰门后，配合静默振动表实现“无感”安检。
  • 全天候野外勤务：具备 IP65 全防护性能与大容量锂电续航，在大型运动会或临时外勤保障中表现极其稳定。
  • 精准空间定位：将人体探测区划分为独立三段，辅助安检员在保持社交距离的前提下快速排查嫌疑部位。
  • Figure 1 Intelligent Ferromagnetic Detection Pillar
detail_html_en:
Features

  • High-Fidelity Fluxgate Architecture: a leading passive detection solution capable of sensing micro-distortions in the magnetic field, superior to traditional gates for static metal items.
  • Passive Safety Commitment: the device emits zero magnetic or heat radiation, ensuring 100% safety for pregnant travelers, pacemaker users, and sensitive storage media.
  • Hierarchical Risk Analysis: when networked, the system codes materials based on flux density signatures—signaling Low (Lighter), Medium (Phone), or High (Weapon) threats via LED color coding.
  • Covert Screening Capability: the minimalist cylindrical design allows for deployment behind walls or décor; pairs with vibrating watches for a non-intrusive checking experience.
  • Field-Ready Endurance: features IP65 weatherproofing and massive Li-ion capacity for reliable multi-day missions at outdoor events or temporary roadside checkpoints.
  • 3-Zone Spatial Accuracy: segments the detection field into vertical quadrants to help personnel isolate threats quickly while maintaining a safe operational distance.
